caption: Training curves on the synthetic dataset. We refer our readers to Figure <ref> in Appendix <ref> for a visualization of the synthetic dataset.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates training accuracy over epochs for several different models. The x-axis, labeled “Epoch,” displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 380, with tick labels spaced approximately every 20 epochs; at the beginning of the x-axis, the value is 0, and at the end, the value is 380. The y-axis, labeled “Training Accuracy,” ranges from approximately 0.2 to 0.8, with tick labels spaced evenly between these values. A purple line, represented by a solid line, initially exhibits a low accuracy, around 0.3 at epoch 0, and gradually increases to approximately 0.85 by epoch 380. A blue line, represented by a dashed line, starts with an accuracy close to 0.2 and increases to approximately 0.7 at epoch 380. A gray line, represented by a solid line, begins with an accuracy of approximately 0.4 and steadily increases to approximately 0.98 by epoch 380. Finally, a black line, represented by a solid line, begins with an accuracy of approximately 0.3 and steadily increases to approximately 0.87 by epoch 380.
